text:
```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ai
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'src/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'src/**'

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build main package
        run: npm run build --prefix src/main

      - name: Build site
        run: npm run build --prefix site

      - name: Deploy to gh-pages
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/ai'
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./site/dist

      - name: Deploy to Surge
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          npm install -g surge
          surge --project ./site/dist --domain gpt-vis.surge.sh
```

This workflow file automates the deployment of the GPT-Vis site to GitHub Pages when changes are pushed to the `ai` branch and to Surge for PR previews. It includes steps for checking out the code, setting up Node.js, installing dependencies, building the main package and the site, and deploying them accordingly. The workflow is triggered on pushes to the `ai` branch and on pull requests with changes to the `site` or `src` directories.
